data.name: describe_phenotype
data.summary: Microscopist on 2 field(s): density lower vs DMSO; 8 observations; candidates: none

observations.finding: DMSO control f_ad322e23a39f: dense epithelial sheet with tightly packed polygonal cells and continuous cortical actin (red) bordering sheet. Treated fields f_ccac39aa0c66 and f_93d2150022f9 at 1.0uM (1024x819 px) are consistent with each other: markedly less confluent, cells as scattered small clusters and isolated spindle-shaped cells with pointed protrusions/spiky edges and gaps between clusters. Identical contrast settings, so difference is biological.

DNA (blue, DAPI): nuclei mononucleated, intact, no fragmentation, no multinucleation, no giant/lobed nuclei. Subtle shape change vs DMSO: more nuclei appear slightly elliptical/elongated with less round outline.

DNA detail: nuc_form_factor strongly decreased (value 0.907 vs DMSO median 0.918, robust z=-8.776) and nuc_eccentricity increased (0.653 vs 0.605, z=+3.384); nuc_solidity slightly decreased (0.971 vs 0.972, z=-2.985). Visually the increased ellipticity and slightly more irregular contour agrees with those strong/moderate deviations. nuc_dna_integrated modestly decreased (359.0 vs 393.2, z=-2.303, |z|<3 not strong) – visually blue intensity not markedly dimmer.

beta-tubulin (green): filamentous cytoplasmic network retained in treated fields, intensity similar to DMSO, no obvious loss, bundling, or diffuse clearing. 2-3 bright rounded green+red=yellow/white cells per treated field similar to 1-2 in DMSO control - no enrichment of mitotic spindles.

F-actin (red): cortical actin still present at cell periphery, enriched at edges of isolated cells and protrusions. No collapse into aggregates, no stress-fiber cables typical of strong actin disruptors, no complete loss. Texture slightly more heterogeneous/contrasty than uniform DMSO cortical belt.

Actin texture agreement: act_std increased (0.102 vs 0.092, z=+2.315) and act_glcm_contrast increased (0.002 vs 0.002, z=+2.472) – moderate increases, |z|<3, consistent with visually more variable protrusive edges.

Cell shape: treated cells less solid and less round than DMSO – spiky, elongated outlines with projections. Measured cell_solidity decreased (0.821 vs 0.832, z=-2.96) and cell_roundness decreased (0.514 vs 0.534, z=-2.228), both moderate |z|~2-3, agreeing visually.

Cell number: ~70-90 nuclei per composite field visible, total 170 cells measured across two treated wells per provided data – lower density than DMSO sheet but no massive cell loss/debris field. Not covered by a cell-count z-score in top deviations.

notable_cells.why: no separate grayscale channels provided – reading stains from colour in composite only

report.uncertainty: low to moderate; subtle shape/texture changes only, no hallmark MoA phenotype in composite image alone without single-channel grayscale confirmation. Need tubulin and actin grayscale and DNA integrated features to rule out weak effects. Concentration 1 uM may be below threshold for strong MoA signature. No comparison to other concentrations/timepoints provided. Images alone lack resolution to assess fine microtubule or actin filament organization or binucleate counts needed for Aurora/Eg5/microtubule classes. No obvious enrichment or depletion in any channel beyond described deviations. Microtubule, Aurora, actin, DNA-damage signatures lack required evidence. Epithelial, cholesterol, kinase inhibitor, degradation, synthesis classes lack characteristic morphological hallmarks here. Measurements show only one strong deviation, limited to nuclear shape, insufficient to assign a specific class. All observed deviations are modest except nuc_form_factor/nuc_eccentricity, which are insufficient alone to claim a mechanism. Therefore insufficient evidence for any listed mechanism.

data.note:
Reflection on specimen s_2cdd0232ac (PP-2):

Unblinding: PubChem CID 4878, structure agrees with BBBC021 annotation (e20). ChEMBL CHEMBL406845 has no curated MoA (e20). BBBC021 annotates as 'Epithelial'. My conclusion 'Protein synthesis' was incorrect.

Atlas analysis: NSC vote 3/4 Protein synthesis with high cosine 0.892 at 10uM to anisomycin and 0.844 at 3uM (e9) and k-neighbors 7-8/10 Protein synthesis (e4,e9) drove prior. Per-well nearest at 1uM was Microtubule destabilizer demecolcine 0.70, indicating instability across doses. Epithelial neighbors (AZ-J) were present at similarity 0.78-0.79 in top 10 (e9) but underweighted. I followed the vote instead of recognizing that 'Epithelial' is a heterogeneous BBBC21 class for kinase/adhesion modulators that overlaps morphologically with translation inhibitors at high dose (nuclear shrinkage rho -1.0 e12, act_mean rho +1.0 e14, reduced nuc area/form_factor e3,e7).

Literature check confirms PP2 is a canonical Src-family kinase inhibitor: PMID 30250573 describes PP2 as Src kinase inhibitor regulating PI3K/Akt, PMID 21052789 shows PP2 inhibition of phospho-Src/EGFR in cancer cells, PMID 35586977 shows protection via SRC inhibition. This matches epithelial scattering phenotype seen at 1uM: loss of confluent sheet, spiky protrusive cells, heterogeneous cortical actin (e6) - subtle kinase signal below strong-protein-synthesis threshold. At 10uM, mitotic/yellow rounding and irregular nuclei (e5) was misinterpreted as mitotic arrest but is secondary to Src inhibition cytoskeletal stress.

Lesson: high atlas similarity to anisomycin/cycloheximide (e21) should not override (1) low-dose epithelial morphology, (2) heterogeneous Epithelial class definition, and (3) orthogonal validation. Next lab experiment would be Src target engagement: phospho-Src Y416 western + E-cadherin junction imaging with PP2 vs dasatinib control, not just OPP translation assay.

reflection.text:
Unblinded truth: PP-2 (PubChem CID 4878, ChEMBL CHEMBL406845, e19/e20) - verdict incorrect. I concluded Protein synthesis p=0.80 (e17/e18) vs true Epithelial.

What the literature confirms: PP-2 is a Src-family kinase inhibitor, not a translation inhibitor. This is consistent across the search hit 'PP2 Src kinase inhibitor mechanism' (e22, 663 hits) and returned titles: PMID 30250573 [Src kinase inhibitor PP2 regulates via PI3K/Akt], PMID 21052789 [Src family kinase inhibitor PP2 inhibits cervical cancer via phospho-Src-Y416], PMID 35586977 [PP2 protects from keratin mutation-associated liver injury and filament disruption via SRC inhibition], PMID 12842900 and PMID 25736120. No paper in this run supports direct protein synthesis inhibition by PP-2, and lookup_compound showed no curated MoA (e19/e20/e21), so I had no ChEMBL anchor to counter atlas similarity.

What I got right:
- e2/e3/e7/e8 captured a strong morphologic trajectory: nuc_form_factor z=-8.8 at 1uM to -20.9 at 10uM, nuc_solidity -3.0 to -13.0, act_glcm_contrast +5.0 at 3uM to +9.8 at 10uM. Dose-dependent nuclear shape loss and actin texture increase was real.
- e10/e12/e14 correctly rejected DNA replication / Aurora: nuc_dna_integrated rho=-1.00 p=0 and nuc_area rho=-1.00 p=0 (nuclear shrinkage, not enlargement/polyploidy), nuc_dna_mean rho=-0.40 p=0.6 flat, frac_mitotic_like rho=+0.40 p=0.6 flat. This plus e6 (microscopist 2 fields at 1uM: density lower but candidates: none) argued against classic mitotic arrest, which I correctly down-weighted in e17.
- e5 was misleading visual call (Aurora/Eg5/Microtubule destabilizers at high dose 10uM) that I appropriately flagged as contradicting for Protein synthesis in e17.

What misled me and why:
- Over-reliance on compare_to_reference_atlas NSC vote. With 2 wells I got Protein synthesis 1/2 (e4) and k-neighbors 8/10 Protein synthesis, 1/10 Epithelial, 1/10 Microtubule destabilizers; with 4 wells 3/4 Protein synthesis, 7/10 Protein synthesis, 2/10 Epithelial (e9). I treated high similarity at 10uM/3uM (rationale in e18: 0.89/0.84) as confirmatory, and collapsed Epithelial probability to 0.02 in e17 despite k-neighbors retaining Epithelial signal increasing from 1/10 to 2/10. The atlas Protein synthesis class dominated because its actin/nuclear irregularity mimics Src/keratin-dependent epithelial remodeling seen with PP-2 - PMID 35586977 explicitly links PP2 to keratin filament disruption, an epithelial cytoskeletal phenotype, not translation stress.
- I mis-attributed e14 act_mean rho=+1.00 p=0 and e16 frac_large_nucleus rho=+1.00 p=0 as supporting protein synthesis. Both are also expected for Src inhibition altering cell spreading, adhesion and cortical actin (hence elevated actin contrast in e3/e7 and eccentricity in e2), but I had no orthogonal protein synthesis assay to test. My planned next experiment (OP-puro incorporation, e18) was correct in principle but not executed; I submitted with 4/4 wells used per e1 budget view but actually left the 0.01uM and 30uM extremes unsampled and performed no replicates or free analyse_morphology as review suggested.
- I ignored the weak cell_count dose correlation (rho=-0.40 p=0.6 e15) which fits Epithelial cytostatic/morphologic effect better than potent protein synthesis cytotoxicity, and I under-weighted the 353 cell count at 10uM (e3) and 362 at 3uM (e7) - maintenance of cell numbers with strong shape change points to cytoskeletal/adhesion MoA, not global translation shutdown.
- Acquisition choice: sequential single-well sampling at 1uM (e2), 10uM (e3), 3uM (e7), 0.3uM (e8) without replication and without a DMSO-anchored multiparametric dose-response plot caused anchoring on the first atlas vote. Searching 'Cell Painting epithelial phenotype actin cytoskeleton' returned 0 hits (e23), leaving me with no literature prior to recalibrate atlas similarity toward Epithelial.

Lesson: when k-neighbors persistently retain 10-20% Epithelial votes and compound is a known Src inhibitor per PMID 30250573, PMID 21052789, PMID 35586977, a 0.80 protein synthesis call on nuclear shape + actin texture alone is overconfident. Need to reserve probability for kinase/epithelial cytoskeletal classes and require orthogonal translation vs phospho-Src/EGFR and keratin filament assays before concluding.
what_was_right: e2/e3/e7 dose-dependent nuc_form_factor and act_glcm_contrast captured real actin/cortical remodeling
e10/e12/e14 correctly excluded DNA replication/Aurora via nuc_dna_integrated rho=-1.00 and nuc_area rho=-1.00
e4/e9 provided persistent Epithelial k-neighbor signal 1/10 -> 2/10 that was a true flag
what_was_wrong: e4/e9 NSC vote 3/4 Protein synthesis over-weighted vs Epithelial 2/10 k-neighbors
e14 act_mean rho=+1.00 and e3/e7 actin contrast misinterpreted as translation inhibition not Src/epithelial actin remodeling per PMID 35586977, PMID 30250573, PMID 21052789
e5 visual Aurora/Eg5 call was incorrectly used to prune mitotic but not to question atlas Protein synthesis dominance
e19/e20 lookup showing no curated MoA left no prior to correct atlas, and e23 zero literature hits for epithelial phenotype removed recalibration opportunity

citations.claim: PP2 described as Src kinase inhibitor, not protein synthesis inhibitor
PP2 described as Src family kinase inhibitor acting via phospho-Src
PP2 linked to keratin filament disruption via SRC inhibition, consistent with Epithelial morphology

reflection.next_experiment: PP2 Epithelial/Src validation uses acquired wells only plus orthogonal assay: re-run compare_to_reference_atlas stratified by dose focusing on Epithelial vs Protein synthesis neighbors, quantify cortical actin / cell-cell contact features, and run phospho-Src Y416 and OP-puro incorporation with anisomycin control to directly discriminate Src-epithelial from translation inhibition.

Both are also expected for Src inhibition altering cell spreading, adhesion and cortical actin (hence elevated actin contrast in e3/e7 and eccentricity in e2), but I had no orthogonal protein synthesis assay to test. My planned next experiment (OP-puro incorporation, e18) was correct in principle but not executed; I submitted with 4/4 wells used per e1 budget view but actually left the 0.01uM and 30uM extremes unsampled and performed no replicates or free analyse_morphology as review suggested.
- I ignored the weak cell_count dose correlation (rho=-0.40 p=0.6 e15) which fits Epithelial cytostatic/morphologic effect better than potent protein synthesis cytotoxicity, and I under-weighted the 353 cell count at 10uM (e3) and 362 at 3uM (e7) - maintenance of cell numbers with strong shape change points to cytoskeletal/adhesion MoA, not global translation shutdown.
- Acquisition choice: sequential single-well sampling at 1uM (e2), 10uM (e3), 3uM (e7), 0.3uM (e8) without replication and without a DMSO-anchored multiparametric dose-response plot caused anchoring on the first atlas vote. Searching 'Cell Painting epithelial phenotype actin cytoskeleton' returned 0 hits (e23), leaving me with no literature prior to recalibrate atlas similarity toward Epithelial.

Lesson: when k-neighbors persistently retain 10-20% Epithelial votes and compound is a known Src inhibitor per PMID 30250573, PMID 21052789, PMID 35586977, a 0.80 protein synthesis call on nuclear shape + actin texture alone is overconfident. Need to reserve probability for kinase/epithelial cytoskeletal classes and require orthogonal translation vs phospho-Src/EGFR and keratin filament assays before concluding.

What was right:
- e2/e3/e7 dose-dependent nuc_form_factor and act_glcm_contrast captured real actin/cortical remodeling
- e10/e12/e14 correctly excluded DNA replication/Aurora via nuc_dna_integrated rho=-1.00 and nuc_area rho=-1.00
- e4/e9 provided persistent Epithelial k-neighbor signal 1/10 -> 2/10 that was a true flag

What was wrong or missed:
- e4/e9 NSC vote 3/4 Protein synthesis over-weighted vs Epithelial 2/10 k-neighbors
- e14 act_mean rho=+1.00 and e3/e7 actin contrast misinterpreted as translation inhibition not Src/epithelial actin remodeling per PMID 35586977, PMID 30250573, PMID 21052789
- e5 visual Aurora/Eg5 call was incorrectly used to prune mitotic but not to question atlas Protein synthesis dominance
- e19/e20 lookup showing no curated MoA left no prior to correct atlas, and e23 zero literature hits for epithelial phenotype removed recalibration opportunity

Proposed next experiment: PP2 Epithelial/Src validation uses acquired wells only plus orthogonal assay: re-run compare_to_reference_atlas stratified by dose focusing on Epithelial vs Protein synthesis neighbors, quantify cortical actin / cell-cell contact features, and run phospho-Src Y416 and OP-puro incorporation with anisomycin control to directly discriminate Src-epithelial from translation inhibition.
